debug.description: Enable debug logging for verbose output (use only for troubleshooting).

worker_count.description: Number of worker processes to handle event listener requests.

evaluation_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between alarm evaluation cycles (minimum 10s recommended).

batch_size.description: Maximum number of notifications to batch and send per cycle.

notification_retry_delay.description: Delay (in seconds) between notification delivery retry attempts.

api_bind_host.description: IP address or hostname for the Aodh listener API to bind to.

api_port.description: TCP port for the Aodh listener API.

api_enable_ssl.description: Enable TLS/SSL for the API endpoint (requires valid cert/key paths).

api_ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file (used only if SSL enabled).

api_ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (used only if SSL enabled).

keystone_auth_url.description: Keystone identity service endpoint URL (must include version, e.g., /v3).

keystone_project_name.description: Keystone project (tenant) name used for service authentication.

keystone_user_domain_name.description: Keystone user domain name for authentication.

keystone_project_domain_name.description: Keystone project domain name for authentication.

keystone_username.description: Keystone service username (must have appropriate roles and project access).

keystone_password.description: Password for the Aodh service user in Keystone (leave empty to use other auth types).

keystone_disable_ssl_certificate_validat.description: Skip TLS verification for Keystone communication (dangerous — only for dev/test).

keystone_cafile.description: Optional path to CA certificate bundle for self-signed or internal Keystone.

memcached_servers.description: List of Memcached server hosts (host:port), used for caching.

event_handlers.description: List of event handler configurations to process incoming events (e.g., for alarm triggering). Each entry defines an event type and an action.

action.description: Action to invoke when event matches (e.g., 'log', 'http', 'workflow').

database_max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries on database connection failure (-1 = infinite).

database_retry_interval.description: Seconds between database connection retry attempts.

publisher_uri.description: Message bus URI (e.g., RabbitMQ or Redis) for publishing telemetry events.

evaluator_batch_size.description: Maximum number of alarms to evaluate in each batch cycle.

notification_method.description: Default method for sending alarm notifications (e.g., 'log', 'http', 'email').

alarm_notification_methods.description: List of additional alarm notification method configurations. Each item must define a 'type' and may include parameters.

name.description: Optional descriptive name for the notification method.
